annotations.text:
Veri, redesigned around the AI-native SDLC loop.
Home becomes The Loop: six stages, artifacts committed at each, your attention at the gates. The stamp queue becomes the Gate Queue (review what the agent flagged). The graph view gains a Change Trace: one turn of the loop as the audit trail.
Same canon: dark ember theme, Source Sans 3 / JetBrains Mono, existing topbar, rail, and card anatomy.
